card.name: Subject nouns just before is/are
card.fires_on: The subject noun (or its verb) at the start of a statement about a general topic, such as rainfall, winds, space, symptoms, or side effects. It fires on the noun itself or on the is/are that follows it.

modes.label: Verb after a topic noun
modes.description: The is or are right after an uncountable or plural subject noun, such as weather or availability.

modes.label: Symptom or effect nouns as subject
modes.description: Nouns like Symptoms, effects or Overdoses that start a clause describing a condition or drug.

card.plain: It fires on the subject of a sentence, such as symptoms, side effects or rainfall, just as the sentence is about to say something about it.
